name: Bazecor Layer Lens
author: Jon Kinney
description: Makes Bazecor's Layer Lens overlay behave like an overlay on Hyprland: floating, following you across workspaces, and bordered in your theme.

service.description: Window rules for Bazecor's Layer Lens overlay. Wayland gives an app no way to place or pin its own window, so the compositor has to be told — this keeps that in one place instead of hand-edited Hyprland config.

schema.label: Keep the overlay floating
schema.description: Stops the keyboard overlay being tiled into your layout. Bazecor asks to float by using a fixed size, but that can lose a race at startup — this settles it.

schema.label: Overlay follows you across workspaces
schema.description: An overlay you can only see on one workspace is not much of an overlay. Wayland has no way for the app to ask for this itself, so the rule lives here.

schema.label: Border in your theme colour
schema.description: Uses the current Omarchy theme's active border colour while the overlay is focused, and no border at all when it is not. Re-read whenever you change theme.

schema.label: Reopen the overlay where you left it
schema.description: Bazecor hides Layer Lens by unmapping its window, and a Wayland app cannot ask to be placed anywhere, so the compositor otherwise picks a new spot each time. This watches where you put it and puts it back.
